system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Wood Release

The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting their nature release with unmatched power. You can add your highest jutsu ability modifier to your Jutsu’s damage if you don’t already.

Additionally, once per rest, you can designate a different clan as your Rival Clan. When you encounter a hostile creature from your Rival Clan you gain a +1 to attacks made and your Jutsu Save DC against these creatures.
